feat(publishing): canonical Standard.site readers and PDS record management

Publishing files a Standard.site publication and document in the writer's own
ATProto repository, and Twyne now serves the matching public reading pages at
/at/<did>/<publication>/<document> so a published piece has a canonical,
verifiable home rather than only a record in a PDS.

The share panel remembers the record key locally, which is what makes update
and unpublish possible on a later visit — the PDS stays the source of truth
while IDB only remembers the handle needed to address the record again. A
catch-all verification route answers the well-known ownership checks.
